correctness.rationale: The three real-axis intensities recover |c|²+|d|², |c|²−|d|², and Re(c conjugate(d)) by their even and odd differences; the fourth recovers the imaginary part exactly when sin(πkα)≠0. At zero sine the two choices d=±i with c=1 collide. Any three magnitudes leave a nonzero Hermitian kernel matrix. For spanning evaluation vectors it must be indefinite, and its two rank-one spectral parts give the ambiguity; for nonspanning vectors there is already an invisible coefficient vector. The interference Gram matrix has trace 3 and determinant 2sin²(πkα), so the least singular value is g(∥kα∥) with g(d)/d→π√(2/3). A minimizing index j_N tends to infinity and Nγ_N≥j_N s_{j_N}, while Nγ_N≤Ns_N, giving the stated liminf. For golden-ratio sharpness one can bypass the redundant initial Fibonacci indexing: with α′=−φ and p nearest to qα, |(qα−p)(qα′−p)|=|p²+pq−q²|≥1 and |qα′−p|≤√5q+1/2. This proves the lower sharpness bound; Hurwitz gives the upper bound. Finally the two witness vectors have squared norms 5 and mutual inner-product modulus 4, giving quotient distance √2, while the interference differences have the stated signs and sizes.
residual_risks: The interference spectrum is for extracted equally weighted coefficients, not raw full-line noise or the conditioning of the four-sample nonlinear inverse.

residual_risks: The exact spectral equivalence is not a claim about independent authorship or publication chronology. The exact four-site realization's absolute priority is unresolved.

value.rationale: A sharp conditioning design for prescribed observations is a worthwhile aim, but here the central optimized invariant is extracted mechanically from the known wider spectrum and classical Hurwitz constant. The four raw samples furnish a clean minimal realization of a two-dimensional lifted system, and the elementary witness illustrates failure near resonance, but neither introduces a new stability invariant or result beyond that routine realization substantial enough to sustain the headline finding. In particular no sharp design or noise guarantee for the raw samples is obtained.
residual_risks: The numerical constant can be useful even as a consequence; a distinct optimality theorem for a raw measurement norm or new signal class is not evaluated here.
